keyVerseDR: "Thou art Christ, the Son of the living God." (Mt 16:16)

level1.title: Who Is Jesus?
level1.story: Jesus asked, "Who do you say that I am?" Peter said, "You are the Christ, the Son of God!" Jesus gave Peter the keys of the Kingdom.
level1.keyLine: Jesus is the Son of God.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are the Son of God. Amen.

activity.title: Guess the saint
activity.intro: Read the clues. Who is it?
clues: Jesus changed my name from Simon.
Jesus gave me the keys of the kingdom.

level2.title: You Are Peter
level2.story: Jesus asked His disciples, "Who do people say that the Son of Man is?" They said some thought He was John the Baptist, Elijah, or Jeremiah. Then Jesus asked, "But who do you say that I am?" Simon Peter answered, "Thou art Christ, the Son of the living God." Jesus said, "Thou art Peter; and upon this rock I will build My Church," and He gave Peter the keys of the kingdom of heaven.
level2.keyLine: Thou art Christ, the Son of the living God.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus give Peter the keys?
How would you answer Jesus' question?
actions: Say who Jesus is to a friend
level2.prayer: Jesus, I believe You are the Christ. Amen.

activity.title: What do we believe?
items: Peter said Jesus is the Son of the living God.
Jesus said He would build His Church on Peter.
Everyone already knew Jesus was the Christ.
Jesus gave Peter the keys of the kingdom.
